verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs state that its core engines (Chandra, Marker, Surya) 'remain free open source', and Marker has a public GitHub repository, so some of the product's source is readable. However, the hosted platform (pipelines, form filling, track changes, on-prem containers) is shown only as a paid or enterprise offering, and no specific license is named. missing for 10: named license terms (e.g., OSI license identification), evidence that the platform/API source beyond the core libraries is open, independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
